referents.why: third masculine plural suffix on 'secret arts' (בְּלָטֵיהֶם); the arts belong to the soothsayer-priests who are the subject of cl0, the only masculine plural agent in the verse that practises them
referents.category: possessive suffix on an instrument noun

referents.why: third common plural implied subject of 'were not able'; the verb of ability completes the magicians' own attempt in cl0/cl1 (bring forth the gnats), so it is the same doers; the gnats cannot be agreeing plural doers of 'being able'
referents.category: implied subject of a negated ability verb continuing the attempt

links.why: lamed + infinitive construct 'to bring forth the gnats' states what the enchantments were done to achieve; it is not an infinitive completing the main verb
links.category: lamed infinitive stating the aim of an attempt

links.why: cl4 is not a clause of this verse (it is the previous verse's qatal 'all the dust became gnats', a background summary); 'then' is within a verse only, and the wayyiqtol cl0 does not narrate an event following that summary but a parallel imitation
links.category: cross-verse then link from a background clause

links.why: the waw before 'not they were able' is a plain 'and', but the sense is the stronger, more specific failed_result: an attempt with a purpose followed by a negated verb of being able; the plain 'and' is replaced by that link
links.category: plain and where the sense is a failed attempt

links.why: cl0 is an attempt with a purpose (cl1), then waw + 'not they were able': the purpose was not achieved
links.category: attempt whose purpose is not achieved

links.why: cl2 is a negated state, not an event, and cl3 'the gnats were on man and beast' does not happen after the failure: the gnats were already there from the previous verse, so the sense is a concurrent, resumed state, not a next event
links.category: wayyiqtol of a continuing state read as the next event

links.why: wayyiqtol 'they did thus' (ken) with a NAMED subject (the magicians) who are not carrying out a command: imitation of what Aaron did, striking the dust so gnats came; imitation, not fulfilment
links.category: rivals imitating a deed with ken

none_fit.what: cl3 repeats the previous verse's 'the gnats were on man and beast' word for word, as a resumption after the magicians' failure, so that it stands as the unrefuted fact; no link type states resumption by repetition or a contrast with no contrast particle

none_fit.where: cl0 to cl2 as one unit
none_fit.what: the magicians' attempt and its failure are one episode (imitate, try, fail), but the 'acts' kind does not fit since cl0 names its subject in a noun and cl2 only in the verb; no group kind for an attempt-and-outcome pair

cant_tell.what: Which deed the 'so' of cl0 copies: Aaron's striking of the dust (Exo.8.13#cl2) or the gnats' coming (Exo.8.13#cl3)
cant_tell.why: the pro-form does not say; the magicians' aim (bring forth the gnats) matches the outcome, but the method they imitate is the striking; the link points to cl2 and the choice is left open
